p2rank_predicted_no_pocket_at_all.consequence: with no call made, precision is 0/0 and MCC's denominator carries a zero factor, so both are undefined and the unit leaves those two comparisons. Recall and F1 are defined and equal zero, so it stays in those
p2rank_predicted_no_pocket_at_all.which_way_this_cuts: it removes a unit where P2Rank found nothing from P2Rank's precision and MCC averages, so both figures below flatter P2Rank rather than us. The F1 and recall figures, which keep the unit, do not
p2rank_predicted_no_pocket_at_all.the_asymmetry_itself: a fixed per-chain budget always answers; native pocket assignment can decline to. That is a difference in deployment behaviour, not in score quality

what_the_paper_must_now_say.headline: p2rank_advantage_appears
what_the_paper_must_now_say.headline_sentence: On 57 external units the counting field leads P2Rank by +0.0443 in mean paired per-unit ROC-AUC, 95% interval [+0.0162, +0.0724], on a set whose labels were fixed before any method was run and whose proteins share no UniRef50 cluster with CryptoBench. This is the paper's first confirmatory accuracy result. It is reported together with the three respects in which the external set is easier than CryptoBench.
what_the_paper_must_now_say.plmnn_sentence: The deficit against CryptoBench's own supervised baseline replicates externally: -0.0340 in mean paired per-unit ROC-AUC, 95% interval [-0.0701, -0.0006], against -0.0243 on the official fold. A supervised network over a protein language model remains the more accurate method.
what_the_paper_must_now_say.chosen_by: the plan's own decision table, applied to the numbers above; the sentences were written before the read

the_commitment: no architecture, threshold, feature, quantisation rule, partition bank or post-processing step changes in response to this read. If the numbers are bad they are published bad. A method retuned against its own external validation set does not have one
